name: Corn/Soybean Ratio — Seasonal Dashboard
description: Corn/soybean price ratio dashboard focused on where the current ratio sits vs seasonal average. Uses ZC and ZS front-month continuation futures with NoAdjustment to preserve true price relationships. Shows: (1) summary table with current ratio, seasonal norm, and deviation; (2) line chart of ratio with 20d MA and seasonal norm overlay; (3) monthly seasonal bar chart highlighting planting season context (Feb–May).
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN/SOYBEAN RATIO — SEASONAL DASHBOARD
# =============================================================================
#
# Focus: Where does the current C/S ratio sit vs its seasonal average?
# Relevant for planting season context (Feb–May).
#
# NoAdjustment preserves real price levels for cross-commodity ratio analysis.
# BackwardPanamaCanal would destroy the ratio over long histories due to
# cumulative additive shifts differing between corn and soybeans.
# =============================================================================

# --- Primary: ZC (Corn) with NoAdjustment ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

zc = cont.c

# --- Reference: ZS (Soybeans) via futures_continuation ---
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_ref.o, zs_ref.h, zs_ref.l, zs_ref.c, zs_ref.v, zs_ref.oi, zs_ref.s)
zs = zs_cont.c

# --- C/S Ratio & 20d MA ---
ratio = zc / zs
ratio_ma20 = ma(period=20)(ratio)

# --- Calendar month extraction ---
ts = index()
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Seasonal norm: expanding mean per calendar month ---
is_jan = month_num == 1
is_feb = month_num == 2
is_mar = month_num == 3
is_apr = month_num == 4
is_may = month_num == 5
is_jun = month_num == 6
is_jul = month_num == 7
is_aug = month_num == 8
is_sep = month_num == 9
is_oct = month_num == 10
is_nov = month_num == 11
is_dec = month_num == 12

jan_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jan, ratio)))
feb_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_feb, ratio)))
mar_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_mar, ratio)))
apr_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_apr, ratio)))
may_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_may, ratio)))
jun_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jun, ratio)))
jul_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_jul, ratio)))
aug_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_aug, ratio)))
sep_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_sep, ratio)))
oct_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_oct, ratio)))
nov_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_nov, ratio)))
dec_avg = ffill(cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Mean)(where(is_dec, ratio)))

seasonal_norm = conditional_select(
    is_jan, jan_avg,
    is_feb, feb_avg,
    is_mar, mar_avg,
    is_apr, apr_avg,
    is_may, may_avg,
    is_jun, jun_avg,
    is_jul, jul_avg,
    is_aug, aug_avg,
    is_sep, sep_avg,
    is_oct, oct_avg,
    is_nov, nov_avg,
    dec_avg
)

seasonal_dev = (ratio - seasonal_norm) / seasonal_norm

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Summary Table — Ratio, Seasonal Norm, Deviation
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Corn/Soybean Ratio — Seasonal Context',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['C/S Ratio'],
        col_headers=['Current', 'Seasonal Norm', 'Deviation'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(info='Latest C/S ratio', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='Expanding mean for current calendar month', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(info='% deviation from seasonal norm', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Snapshot'
)(ratio, seasonal_norm, seasonal_dev)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: C/S Ratio with 20d MA & Seasonal Norm Overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Corn/Soybean Ratio vs Seasonal Norm',
    category='2. C/S Ratio',
    y_axis_label='C/S Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='C/S Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Seasonal Norm', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio, ratio_ma20, seasonal_norm))

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Monthly Seasonal Bar — Avg Ratio by Calendar Month
# Highlights planting season context (Feb–May)
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Average C/S Ratio by Calendar Month',
    category='2. C/S Ratio',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg C/S Ratio',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    order=2
)(values=ratio, label=month_num)
